description: Returns the free frozen-contract state view for one tracked tokenized treasury: identity, Open Treasury Yield Basis result or explicit unavailable reason, issuer-term evidence cells, verified deployments and evidence dates. Three distinct tickers are free per caller in a rolling hour; repeats stay free, and the fourth returns BREADTH_LIMIT with the paid complete-snapshot path. An omitted ticker returns only the known ticker list.

ticker.description: tracked instrument ticker, case-insensitive. Omit it to receive the complete known ticker list.

name: get_rwa_instrument
title: Get one RWA instrument state
